header: Pages as cards, one line each
lead: An icon, a title and one sentence about the page, in two to four columns. The whole card is the link, and screen readers announce the title.

items.title: Hero & Landing Intros
items.description: The opening section of a page. It says what the product is, who it is for and what to do next.

items.title: Features & Benefits
items.description: Feature grids, benefit lists and comparisons for the middle of a landing page, where claims get specific.

items.title: Content & Editorial
items.description: Elements for long articles: rich text, quotes, media, accordions and everything else an article needs.

items.title: Plans & Pricing
items.description: Plan tables, tier cards and the small print, for the page where visitors compare prices.

items.title: Trust & Social Proof
items.description: Testimonials, logos, ratings and case study teasers that back up a claim.

items.title: People & Team
items.description: Portraits, role cards and team overviews for pages that introduce the people behind the work.
